title: Smart Data Models - FIBO - ListedShare
description: share that is listed on at least one platform (FIBO Production 2026Q3 class fibo-sec-eq-eq:ListedShare, 'listed share'. Attributes derived from the OWL restrictions on this class and its superclasses fibo-sec-eq-eq:Share, fibo-fbc-fi-fi:EquityInstrument, fibo-fbc-fi-fi:Security, fibo-fbc-fi-fi:FinancialInstrument, fibo-sec-sec-lst:ListedSecurity, fibo-sec-sec-lst:RegisteredSecurity; FIBO property names verbatim.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ListedShare'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

isIdentifiedBy.description: Property. Model:'https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/Identifiers/isIdentifiedBy'. has an identifier that is unique within some context. E.g. the ISIN (identifierClass fibo-sec-sec-id:InternationalSecuritiesIdentificationNumber). FIBO restriction: fibo-fbc-fi-fi:FinancialInstrument min 0 fibo-fbc-fi-fi:FinancialInstrumentIdentifier.

hasFinancialInstrumentShortName.description: Property. Model:'https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Securities/SecuritiesIssuance/hasFinancialInstrumentShortName'. relates a security to its ISO 18774-compliant short name, which includes an issuer short name, abbreviated instrument characteristics, and abbreviated instrument description per the ISO standard. Here: the ISO 18774 FISN as text. FIBO restriction: fibo-fbc-fi-fi:FinancialInstrument min 0 fibo-sec-sec-iss:FinancialInstrumentShortName.

hasShareClass.description: Property. Model:'https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Equities/EquityInstruments/hasShareClass'. indicates the class to which the share belongs, typically differentiated by privileges, such as voting rights. FIBO restriction: fibo-sec-eq-eq:Share min 0 xsd:string.

isIssuedBy.description: Relationship. Model:'https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FND/Relations/Relations/isIssuedBy'. indicates a functional entity or party responsible for circulating, distributing, or publishing something. Points to the issuing LegalEntity (FIBO: some Issuer, a role played by the legal entity). FIBO restriction: fibo-fbc-fi-fi:FinancialInstrument some fibo-fbc-fi-fi:Issuer.

isDenominatedIn.description: Property. Model:'https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/FinancialInstruments/FinancialInstruments/isDenominatedIn'. indicates the currency in which the financial instrument was issued. Here: ISO 4217 code. FIBO restriction: fibo-fbc-fi-fi:FinancialInstrument some fibo-fnd-acc-cur:Currency.

isLegallyRecordedIn.description: Property. Model:'https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/FinancialInstruments/FinancialInstruments/isLegallyRecordedIn'. jurisdiction (country, county, state, province, city) in which the financial instrument is legally recorded for regulatory and/or tax purposes. Here: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or ISO 3166-2 code. FIBO restriction: fibo-fbc-fi-fi:Security exactly 1 cmns-rga:Jurisdiction; fibo-fbc-fi-fi:FinancialInstrument min 0 cmns-rga:Jurisdiction.

isNegotiable.description: Property. Model:'https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/FinancialInstruments/FinancialInstruments/isNegotiable'. specifies whether a particular financial instrument is or is not transferable. FIBO restriction: fibo-fbc-fi-fi:FinancialInstrument exactly 1 xsd:boolean.

isClassifiedBy.description: Property. Model:'https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/Classifiers/isClassifiedBy'. is systematically grouped based on characteristics by. E.g. the ISO 10962 CFI code (classifierClass fibo-sec-sec-cls:FinancialInstrumentClassifier). FIBO restriction: fibo-fbc-fi-fi:FinancialInstrument min 0 fibo-sec-sec-cls:FinancialInstrumentClassifier; fibo-fbc-fi-fi:FinancialInstrument min 0 fibo-fnd-arr-cls:IndustrySectorClassifier.

isIssuedInForm.description: Property. Model:'https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Securities/SecuritiesIssuance/isIssuedInForm'. indicates the form in which the security is issued, typically in registered form. Values: FIBO individuals of fibo-sec-sec-iss:SecurityForm as compact IRIs: fibo-sec-sec-iss:BearerAndRegisteredForm (bearer and registered form); fibo-sec-sec-iss:BearerForm (bearer form); fibo-sec-sec-iss:BookEntryForm (book entry form); fibo-sec-sec-iss:MiscellaneousForm (miscellaneous form); fibo-sec-sec-iss:RegisteredForm (registered form). FIBO restriction: fibo-fbc-fi-fi:Security min 0 fibo-sec-sec-iss:SecurityForm; fibo-sec-sec-lst:RegisteredSecurity some {fibo-sec-sec-iss:BearerAndRegisteredForm, fibo-sec-sec-iss:BookEntryForm, fibo-sec-sec-iss:RegisteredForm}.

isRegisteredWith.description: Property. Model:'https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Securities/SecuritiesIssuance/isRegisteredWith'. indicates the registration authority for a given security, i.e., in the name of the owner on the books of the issuer, with the issuer's registrar, with a third-party transfer agent, with a broker-dealer, or other competent party. Here: the name of the registration authority. FIBO restriction: fibo-fbc-fi-fi:Security min 0 cmns-ra:RegistrationAuthority; fibo-sec-sec-lst:RegisteredSecurity some cmns-ra:RegistrationAuthority.

hasRegistrationDate.description: Property. Model:'https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/RegistrationAuthorities/hasRegistrationDate'. indicates the date or date and time on which something is registered. FIBO restriction: fibo-sec-sec-lst:RegisteredSecurity some cmns-dt:CombinedDateTime.

hasHomeExchange.description: Property. Model:'https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Securities/SecuritiesListings/hasHomeExchange'. indicates the exchange that is considered the primary market for a security; typically, but not always, in the country in which the security was originally issued. Here: the ISO 10383 Market Identifier Code (MIC) of the exchange. FIBO restriction: fibo-sec-sec-lst:ListedSecurity exactly 1 fibo-fbc-fct-mkt:Exchange.

hasOriginalPlaceOfListing.description: Property. Model:'https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Securities/SecuritiesListings/hasOriginalPlaceOfListing'. indicates the original exchange that listed the security. Here: ISO 10383 MIC. FIBO restriction: fibo-sec-sec-lst:ListedSecurity exactly 1 fibo-fbc-fct-mkt:Exchange.

hasNominalValue.description: Property. Model:'https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/FinancialInstruments/FinancialInstruments/hasNominalValue'. indicates the face value of a contract. FIBO restriction: fibo-fbc-fi-fi:FinancialInstrument min 0 fibo-fnd-acc-cur:MonetaryAmount.

hasSharesAuthorized.description: Property. Model:'https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/BE/LegalEntities/CorporateBodies/hasSharesAuthorized'. indicates the maximum number of shares that are permitted to be issued, as established by the board of directors. FIBO restriction: fibo-sec-eq-eq:Share some xsd:nonNegativeInteger.

hasSharesIssued.description: Property. Model:'https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Equities/EquityInstruments/hasSharesIssued'. indicates the actual number of shares held by shareholders (i.e., shares outstanding) and treasury shares. FIBO restriction: fibo-sec-eq-eq:Share min 0 xsd:nonNegativeInteger.

hasSharesOutstanding.description: Property. Model:'https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Equities/EquityInstruments/hasSharesOutstanding'. indicates the number of shares currently held by shareholders, including those held by retail investors, institutional investors and insiders, and typically available for trading. FIBO restriction: fibo-sec-eq-eq:Share min 0 xsd:nonNegativeInteger.

hasTreasuryShares.description: Property. Model:'https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Equities/EquityInstruments/hasTreasuryShares'. indicates the number of shares issued but not outstanding, including those that were available in the market at one time but have been repurchased by the company. FIBO restriction: fibo-sec-eq-eq:Share min 0 xsd:nonNegativeInteger.

hasAvailableShares.description: Property. Model:'https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Equities/EquityInstruments/hasAvailableShares'. indicates the number of shares outstanding less those shares that are restricted, i.e., those that are available for trading. FIBO restriction: fibo-sec-eq-eq:Share min 0 xsd:nonNegativeInteger.

hasFloatingStock.description: Property. Model:'https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Equities/EquityInstruments/hasFloatingStock'. indicates the number of shares that are available for trading, i.e., the number of shares outstanding less closely held shares (those held by insiders) and restricted shares. FIBO restriction: fibo-sec-eq-eq:Share min 0 xsd:nonNegativeInteger.

confersNumberOfVotesPerShare.description: Property. Model:'https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Equities/EquityInstruments/confersNumberOfVotesPerShare'. grants the right to vote on a per share basis to the shareholder. FIBO restriction: fibo-sec-eq-eq:Share some xsd:decimal.

hasVotingRestriction.description: Property. Model:'https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Equities/EquityInstruments/hasVotingRestriction'. specifies restrictions on voting rights, if any. FIBO restriction: fibo-sec-eq-eq:Share min 0 xsd:string.

hasSharePaymentStatus.description: Property. Model:'https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Equities/EquityInstruments/hasSharePaymentStatus'. indicates the payment status for shares issued. Values: FIBO individuals of fibo-sec-eq-eq:SharePaymentStatus as compact IRIs: fibo-sec-eq-eq:FullyPaidShareStatus (fully paid share status); fibo-sec-eq-eq:NilPaidShareStatus (nil paid share status); fibo-sec-eq-eq:PartiallyPaidShareStatus (partially paid share status). FIBO restriction: fibo-sec-eq-eq:Share some fibo-sec-eq-eq:SharePaymentStatus.

Classifier.description: OMG Commons cmns-cls:Classifier (and FIBO subclasses), nested: a code from a classification scheme.

classifierClass.description: Not a FIBO term (Smart Data Models addition, stands for rdf:type): the FIBO class of the classifier as a compact IRI, e.g. fibo-fbc-fct-breg:NorthAmericanIndustryClassificationSystemCode, fibo-sec-sec-cls:FinancialInstrumentClassifier (ISO 10962 CFI), fibo-loan-ln-ln:LenderLienPosition.

hasTag.description: Model:'https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/Designators/hasTag'. associates unique combination of alphanumeric characters corresponding to a designator for something Here: the code, or the FIBO individual (compact IRI) when FIBO enumerates the values.

Identifier.description: FIBO / OMG Commons identifier (cmns-id:Identifier and its subclasses), nested. FIBO pattern: the identifier is an individual of its class whose code is given by cmns-dsg:hasTag and which cmns-id:identifies the thing.

identifierClass.description: Not a FIBO term (Smart Data Models addition, stands for rdf:type): the FIBO/Commons class of the identifier: fibo-be-le-lei:LegalEntityIdentifier (legal entity identifier); fibo-be-le-cb:RegistrationIdentifier (registration identifier); fibo-fbc-fct-breg:BusinessRegisterIdentifier (business register identifier); fibo-fbc-fct-fse:BusinessIdentifierCode (business identifier code); fibo-be-le-fbo:ValueAddedTaxIdentificationNumber (value-added tax identification number); fibo-fnd-pty-pty:TaxIdentifier (tax identifier); fibo-sec-sec-id:InternationalSecuritiesIdentificationNumber (international securities identification number); fibo-fbc-fi-fi:FinancialInstrumentIdentifier (financial instrument identifier); fibo-fbc-pas-caa:AccountIdentifier (account identifier); cmns-id:Identifier (identifier).

hasTag.description: Model:'https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/Designators/hasTag'. associates unique combination of alphanumeric characters corresponding to a designator for something Here: the identifier code itself (e.g. the 20-character LEI, the ISIN, the register number).

isRegisteredIn.description: Model:'https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/RegistrationAuthorities/isRegisteredIn'. indicates the registry that something is registered in Here: the registry, given by its GLEIF Registration Authorities List code (e.g. RA000304) or name.

identifies.description: Model:'https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/Identifiers/identifies'. recognizes or establishes identity within some context Here: the NGSI-LD id of the identified entity, when it is in the same system.

MonetaryAmount.description: FIBO fibo-fnd-acc-cur:MonetaryAmount, nested: measure that is an amount of money specified in monetary units. Properties from its restrictions (hasAmount exactly 1, hasCurrency exactly 1).

hasCurrency.description: Model:'https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FND/Accounting/CurrencyAmount/hasCurrency'. specifies the medium of exchange value in which something, such as a monetary amount is denominated Here: ISO 4217 alphabetic code (FIBO links the ISO 4217 currency individuals).
